sessions.phase_label: Model scoping, input selection, and financial-method specification
Model construction, usability review, and reporting redesign

requirements.title: Eight-Site Network Configuration
requirements.definition: Configure the financial model around the eight-site network identified in the Business Case, with unavailable site-level details represented through explicit modeling assumptions.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the modeled site universe and site-level configuration only; site capex, operating costs, and revenue calculations are independently changeable modules.

requirements.title: Model Currency and Price Basis
requirements.definition: Use a consistent model-wide currency and price base, initially specified as CAD with a 2026 base year.
requirements.boundary_note: Currency and base year are coupled model-basis parameters; they are distinct from the numerical capex, opex, revenue, and financing assumptions.

requirements.title: Capital Expenditure Modeling
requirements.definition: Model site-level and program-wide capital expenditures, including site typologies, digital-platform costs, program management, and contingency or reserve amounts.
requirements.boundary_note: Site and shared-program capex categories are attributes of one capital-cost module; operating expenses and revenue forecasts have independent assumptions and calculations.

requirements.title: Operating Expenditure Modeling
requirements.definition: Model operating expenditures for the complete network using the client-confirmed program-level operating-cost basis.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the operating-cost calculation module, including its program-level range; it excludes capital expenditures and revenue drivers.

requirements.title: Multi-Stream Revenue Modeling
requirements.definition: Model the project's revenue streams, including parking, pods, fleet contracts or subscriptions, digital-platform revenue, and ancillary revenue.
requirements.boundary_note: The individual revenue streams are driver categories within one revenue-forecast mechanism; no supplied history shows them receiving separate lifecycle or execution trajectories.

requirements.title: Source Data Reconciliation
requirements.definition: Reconcile model inputs against the supplied source documents so that entered figures correspond to the selected authoritative sources and client-confirmed assumptions.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers correctness of entered source data; formula behavior and documentation of assumptions are separately testable integrity obligations.

requirements.title: Assumption Documentation and Traceability
requirements.definition: Clearly identify modeled assumptions and their sources, including assumptions substituted for unavailable firm or site-level information.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the audit trail and labeling of assumptions rather than the substantive values owned by individual capex, opex, revenue, and financing modules.

requirements.title: Formula and Worksheet-Link Integrity
requirements.definition: Ensure formulas, links, and calculation flows operate correctly across the financial model and produce logical, credible outputs.
requirements.boundary_note: Formula execution can fail independently of source-data selection, assumption traceability, dashboard quality, or presentation clarity.

requirements.title: Integrated Financial Statement Model
requirements.definition: Maintain an integrated financial engine with linked financial statements and cash-flow outputs supporting the project-finance analysis.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the integrated statement and cash-flow engine; financing structure, tax treatment, and availability-payment sizing are independent analytical mechanisms.

requirements.title: Capital Stack and Debt Modeling
requirements.definition: Model the project's capital stack and debt schedule using the selected debt/equity structure, financing cost, and tranche treatment, with debt-performance outputs.
requirements.boundary_note: Capital-stack parameters and the debt schedule form one financing engine; availability-payment thresholds and tax calculations remain independently modifiable.

requirements.title: Canadian Tax and CCA Modeling
requirements.definition: Calculate taxes using depreciation and the applicable Canadian Capital Cost Allowance classes for the modeled asset types.
requirements.boundary_note: Tax and CCA treatment has its own calculation rules and can change independently of the financing structure and operating-cost model.

requirements.title: Availability Payment Sizing
requirements.definition: Calculate the availability-style payment endogenously so the project meets the client-confirmed minimum debt-service and equity-return thresholds.
requirements.boundary_note: DSCR and equity-IRR targets are coupled sizing criteria for one payment mechanism; demonstrating the difference between funding scenarios is a separate comparative behavior.

requirements.title: User-Funded and PPP Scenario Comparison
requirements.definition: Compare the user-funded case with the PPP availability-payment case and clearly demonstrate whether user fees alone can make the project viable and bankable.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers comparative scenario outputs and the viability conclusion; the numerical sizing of the availability payment is independently changeable.

requirements.title: Project Sensitivity Analysis
requirements.definition: Provide sensitivity analysis for material project drivers such as traffic, occupancy, capex, interest rates, and operating costs.
requirements.boundary_note: The sensitivity variables are parameters of one scenario-testing mechanism rather than separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Simplified and Auditable Model Interface
requirements.definition: Organize the model so its principal figures and logic are concise, understandable, and easy to review while preserving access to supporting detail.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the spreadsheet's navigability and front-facing level of detail; dashboard content and the separate presentation artifact can be revised independently.

requirements.title: Decision-Maker Dashboard
requirements.definition: Provide dashboards that clearly communicate project returns, debt performance, overall bankability, and the project's investment case.
requirements.boundary_note: The named decision metrics are contents of one dashboard mechanism; the dashboard is distinct from the underlying calculations and companion presentation.

requirements.title: Concise Summary Presentation
requirements.definition: Provide a concise presentation artifact that summarizes the model's investment and bankability conclusions and references the detailed working model.
requirements.boundary_note: The presentation is a separate executable deliverable initiated in direct response to the client's communication concerns; it does not own dashboard or model-calculation behavior.

unresolved_candidates.description: The client clearly requires simplification, but does not select between retaining a visible driver-based structure and using a high-level summary with hidden or backing detail; the exact interface structure remains unresolved.

Case C, transitional revenue sharing, a corridor levy, phased refinancing, and anchor-tenant revenue were freelancer proposals awaiting client selection and are not established Requirements in the supplied history.
